# Extended Discovery Index

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_discovery.py; edit data/discovery.json instead. -->

**374 survey-discovered works**, grouped by boundary/comparison role.

This layer adapts the author-provided survey discovery snapshot (search cutoff 2026-10-07).
It is broader than the curated catalog. The two layers overlap; do not add their counts.
A cataloged work is not necessarily a distinct system, deployment, or reproduced result.

Source checks: 257 metadata-verified; 104 reachable; 13 reference-only.

- **metadata-verified:** identity checked on official arXiv or DOI-registry metadata.
- **reachable:** the primary source opened; this is not a full technical or publication-status audit.
- **reference-only:** a supplied primary link remains, but this pass could not independently check its identity/access.

Publication labels imported from the survey are kept separately as survey-reported metadata.
Descriptions and boundary placement are survey-derived editorial annotations, not independently re-coded system properties.
For curated contribution/scope notes, use the linked curated entry where available.

## Search locally

```bash
python3 scripts/search_papers.py --collection discovery --class O
python3 scripts/search_papers.py --collection all "elastic"
python3 scripts/search_papers.py --collection discovery --year 2026 --json
```

The combined collection keeps a curated record instead of its mapped discovery counterpart. Distinct reports about one system can remain separate works.
Filters can match either representation before deduplication; the returned curated record can therefore use a corrected category/year or different tags from its discovery match.
Use `--collection discovery` to inspect historical survey classification and source-check state explicitly.
